definitions.explanation: A paper or sheet on which answers are written for an examination or test. Can refer to both the blank sheet and the completed answers.

examples.japanese: {答案|とうあん}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
{答案|とうあん}{用紙|ようし}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name on the answer sheet.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{答案|とうあん}を{採点|さいてん}している。
examples.english: The teacher is grading the exam papers.

notes:
USAGE: {答案|とうあん} specifically refers to written answers on examination papers. It's commonly used in school and testing contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{答案|とうあん}を{書|か}く (to write answers)
・{答案|とうあん}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する (to submit answer sheets)
・{答案|とうあん}を{採点|さいてん}する (to grade answer sheets)
・{答案|とうあん}を{返却|へんきゃく}する (to return graded papers)

RELATED WORDS:
・{答案|とうあん}{用紙|ようし} (answer sheet, answer paper)
・{解答|かいとう} (answer, solution)
・{回答|かいとう} (answer, reply)
・{試験|しけん} (examination)
・{採点|さいてん} (grading, scoring)
